title: Lesson 28: I Passed It!
summary: Anna tells her roommate, Marsha, about the problems she had in her driving test. Then Anna says she wants to drive to a special place in Washington, D.C. Where will she drive?
content_md:

Marsha: Anna, did you get your driver’s license?
Anna: I did! But it was not easy.
